data.summary: The Finanzamt Neu Beispielhagen issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 for Wiebke Musterholm, setting taxable income at €36,125 and a refund of €772.00 to be transferred to the stated account. The notice also explains the right to file an objection (Einspruch) if the assessment is considered incorrect.
data.explanation: This is your official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 from the Finanzamt Neu Beispielhagen. Based on your tax return, it calculated a taxable income of €36,125 and a refund of €772.00, which will be paid automatically into the bank account you gave in your return — no action is needed to receive it. If you think the figures are wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, via ELSTER, or in person at the tax office; the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the assessment simply becomes final. Keep this letter, as it documents your 2025 income and deductions for future reference.
